source_title: Dragon Ball Officially Confirms Vegeta is Stronger Than Goku - GameRant
source_excerpt:
Renan is the Anime Lead Editor for GameRant. Ren graduated Cum Laude from Lesley University in 2017 and has been focusing exclusively on his journalistic endeavors ever since. When Ren isn't working, he's usually playing video games or reading.
Goku and Vegeta have been rivals for a long time, but Dragon Ball Z made it painfully clear that Goku was always destined to be stronger. He was the first person to turn into a Super Saiyan, fully mastered the form where Vegeta couldn't, and was able to unlock Super Saiyan 3 – a form Vegeta never obtained in the canon timeline. By the end of DBZ , Goku was so much stronger than Vegeta that the Prince of All Saiyans' arc ended with him straight up accepting that his rival was better.
While Goku was the top dog in Dragon Ball Z , Dragon Ball Super is changing the status quo forever by confirming that Vegeta not only has more potential, but is objectively stronger. Between the latest episode of Dragon Ball Super: Beerus and the upcoming story arcs in Dragon Ball Super 2 , Vegeta is going to beat Goku at his own game – quite literally, in fact. The Prince of All Saiyans is earning Beerus' praise, unlocking powerful new forms, and defeating Goku once and for all.
Beerus Confirmed That Vegeta is Stronger Than Goku
Dragon Ball Super: Beerus Episode 3 makes it very clear that Super Saiyan 2 Vegeta is stronger than Super Saiyan 3 Goku. In the remake, Beerus tells Vegeta that he had more fun fighting him than he did Goku, and that he actually had to use 10% of his true Power Level (which is, shockingly, higher than in the original anime or even Battle of Gods ).
For reference, Super Saiyan God Goku forces Beerus to use 70% of his power in the original movie, so Vegeta is quite strong as your average SSJ2. This is a detail that comes from Akira Toriyama himself. In Battle of Gods , Master Roshi confirms that Vegeta surpassed Goku. The remake chose to cut this piece of dialogue, even though it was written by Toriyama, but Beerus' praise of Vegeta ends up conveying the same message: Vegeta is a greater warrior than Goku.
Vegeta is Going to Surpass Goku For Good in Dragon Ball Super 2
While Dragon Ball Super: Beerus has planted the seed for Vegeta to officially surpass Goku for good, his dreams won't come to fruition until Dragon Ball Super 2 . Beginning with the premiere of Dragon Ball Super: The Galactic Patrol , Vegeta is going to go on an amazing journey that proves he is superior to Goku. In the Moro Saga, Vegeta is going to go to Planet Yardrat so he can learn Spirit Control. Not only will Vegeta prove to be a better Ki master than Goku, he's going to unlock Instant Transmission.
The Dragon Ball Super explicitly calls Vegeta a "prodigy born out of hard work." Everything Vegeta has achieved in his life has been because of how far he pushes himself. That idea is going to reach its zenith in the Granolah the Survivor Saga. With Goku now working on mastering Ultra Instinct, he starts training exclusively under Whis. Meanwhile, Beerus formally takes Vegeta on as not just a student, but a proper disciple.
Dragon Ball Super 2 turns Vegeta into a Hakai master and the obvious next choice to become Universe 7's God of Destruction. Vegeta even unlocks his own personal Destroyer form, Ultra Ego – a transformation that raises his Power Level the longer it's active and the more damage he takes. Ultra Ego is so strong, Vegeta goes from weaker than Goku, to equal to the strongest version of Ultra Instinct at the time. As of the Super Hero Saga, Toyotarou has confirmed that Ultra Ego Vegeta is just as strong as Perfected Ultra Instinct Goku.
The final nail is Goku's coffin, however, is the mere fact that Vegeta is going to beat Goku in a fair fight in Dragon Ball Super 2 . The Super Hero Saga features an arc-long battle where Goku and Vegeta fight in their base forms. In the end, Vegeta just barely beats Goku, confirming that he is the stronger and more skilled Saiyan (in base, at least). Things might change once the manga comes out of hiatus, but heading into the Black Frieza Saga, Vegeta is canonically stronger than Goku.
